Ari / Sofia — thanks, glad the demo landed. Draft MAP attached and a short checklist below — Im proposing a 3-week runway that starts on Monday 12/13 and ends with acceptance on 1/3. If you need an earlier start we can compress but will need two dedicated Redwood engineers on the dev side.

Quick checklist (high level):
1) Org setup: create Nebulite "redwood-staging" org namespace; add users: ari@nebulite.com (owner), sofia.ruiz@nebulite.com (netops), and one service account: nebulite-svc@redwood (used by CI). We'll provide IAM guidance and a bootstrap script.
2) API keys: short-lived API keys by default; we issue a scoped staging key and a next-step production key if acceptance passes. Default rotation: 30 days; recommend ephemeral tokens for automated runners.
3) IP allowlist: for staging endpoints allowlist these ranges (expected): 34.215.0.0/16, 52.10.0.0/16. If you have narrower NAT ranges from us-west-2 please share.
4) VPC peering: we support VPC peering + route propagation. Preferred maintenance window: Tue/Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC to minimize overlap. Peering requires one of your network engineers to share a VPC id + routing table preferences.

Attachments: MAP-draft-nebulite-2026-12.pdf (draft timelines), peering-parameters-nebulite.csv (template).

Action items: Ari to confirm start date and provide VPC id + staging NAT ranges by Thursday EOD. Sofia, can you confirm routing availability for the maintenance window above?

Ill have Marissa follow up on the audit/log artifacts for SOC mapping.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Hi Sofia / Ari — adding some technical detail on what well deliver during the 3-week MAP so your network and security teams can scope validation work:

- Org & IAM: we will provide a Terraform module to bootstrap the "redwood-staging" org, generate a service principal for nebulite-svc, and a role binding document. Estimated time: 1 day to validate with your SREs.
- API keys & rotation: we issue a scoped staging key with limited privileges (generate/score endpoints only). SDKs support automatic refresh via short-lived tokens; I'll include code snippets in the playbook.
- IP allowlist: we will lock to the exact CIDRs Sofia provided in staging and expose a single DNS endpoint per region. If any of your services require egress to Redwood internal collectors we will list those endpoints explicitly.
- VPC peering: engineering notes: we require your VPC id, peer CIDR, and a preferred route table target. Peering setup and verification typically completes in a single 2–3 hour window; smoke tests run immediately after. We'll also provide a route rollback script.

Deliverables for the MAP: staged org access, issued staging key, peering established (green), smoke test report, and an acceptance checklist signed by Nebulite.

I attached a minimal peering parameters CSV (peering-parameters-nebulite.csv) — please populate and return.

Thanks — looping Ben for scheduling the peering window with infra ops.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
